# `aitbc market gpu register`

Register a GPU in the coordinator registry (POST /v1/market/gpu/register). Needs a miner credential (``aitbc auth login`` or ``--api-key``). Idempotent: registering the same name/resource again returns the same id.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc market gpu register [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--name` | text | — | yes | GPU model name, e.g. 'RTX 4060 Ti' |
| `--memory-gb` | integer | — | yes | GPU memory in GB |
| `--price-per-hour` | text | — | yes | Listing price per hour, in AIT (decimal string) |
| `--compute-capability` | text | — | no | CUDA compute capability, e.g. 8.9 |
| `--region` | text | `localhost` | no | Region label |
| `--resource-id` | text | — | no | Energy-floor resource id (enables protected rentals) |
| `--model-id` | text | — | no | Model id for the quote |
| `--protected` | flag | `false` | no | Mark as a protected (energy-floor) resource |
| `--json-output` | flag | `false` | no | Output raw JSON |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc market gpu register --name <name> --memory-gb <memory_gb> --price-per-hour <price_per_hour>
```
